name: ERIS Neuro Control V28
goal: Move routine action selection out of the LLM Executive into bounded workspace competition; use the LLM only for genuine conflict/ambiguity.
core_invariants: Routine clear-winner selection does not call an LLM.
LLM deliberation receives ephemeral local indices only.
Invalid deliberator output returns control to the same fast gate, not to guessed runtime identity.
